text.tspan: Private IP, public IP and Elastic IP on EC2
two networks can reuse the same
static public IPv4 you own until released
attach to one instance at a time; remap
on failure · max 5 per account (soft limit)
all public IPv4 is billed (since Feb 2024)
Avoid: use DNS or a load balancer
